Subject: Next steps & 60–90m ML/Infra immersion — OptiScale

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: OptiScale is evaluating a solution to standardize inference across cloud regions and reduce token costs for multi-tenant features. Key constraints you called out: strict data separation for PII, predictable 95th percentile latency under 150ms for short-chat flows, and an expected 3x throughput spike during marketing campaigns.

Recommended next step: a 60–90 minute technical immersion with our ML/Infra folks to run through:
- current serving architecture and caching/kv-cache strategy
- model selection & quantization tradeoffs for cost targets
- deployment options (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC) and network/security controls
- concrete integration plan & mutual action items

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Nov 24, 10:00–11:30 PT (90m)
- Wed Nov 25, 08:00–09:00 PT (60m) — tight window for EMEA overlap
- Thu Nov 26, 13:00–14:30 PT (90m)

If none of these work, please share 2x preferred windows next week and I will route to our infra leads. Attendees we suggest: Kimberly (you), Ben (Solutions Engineer, runtime + orchestration), Evelyn (Product — rollouts & SLAs), and our ML infra lead (we'll add once time confirmed). Please also confirm your security/compliance contact for a short compliance appendix during the session (SOC2/KMS questions).

I've attached the short discovery notes and a draft agenda to help scope the meeting. Calendar link to propose times: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd1234

Thanks — Kim
